```yaml
name: Replay Benchmark

on:
  schedule:
    # Run every Sunday at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python check_env.py --auto-install

      - name: Run replay benchmark harness
        run: |
          python scripts/run_replay_bench.py

      - name: Upload benchmark results to GitHub Pages
        uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1
        with:
          name: Replay Benchmark
          tool: custom
          output-file-path: docs/bench_history.csv
          gh-pages-branch: gh-pages
          gh-repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          benchmark-data-dir-path: docs
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          auto-push: true
          comment-always: false
          summary-always: false
          save-data-file: true
          comment-on-alert: false
          alert-threshold: 0

      - name: Upload benchmark results as artifact
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/upload-benchmark-results@main
        with:
          benchmark-results-dir: docs
          benchmark-name: Replay Benchmark
          dry-run: false
          schema-version: 1.0
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Ensure README contains benchmark badge
        run: |
          BADGE_URL="https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/workflows/bench.yml/badge.svg"
          BADGE_MARKDOWN="![Replay Benchmark](${BADGE_URL})"
          if ! grep -q "$BADGE_MARKDOWN" README.md; then
            echo "$BADGE_MARKDOWN" >> README.md
          fi

      - name: Commit benchmark history and README changes
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@04702edda442b2e678b25b537cec683a1493fcb9
        with:
          commit_message: "Update benchmark history and README badge"
          file_pattern: "docs/bench_history.csv README.md"
          commit_user_name: "github-actions[bot]"
          commit_user_email: "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          push_options: "--force"
```
